svg.title: Editable ornament studies — draft 01
svg.desc: Five drawer motif variants, repeating top edge leaves, and a fluted foot. Photo interpretations with unverified depths.

g.text: Interpretations from reference photographs · relief depths unverified · no raster images
D-L1 / D-R1 · Upper side drawer — compact crested mask
D-L2 / D-R2 · Second drawer — low crest and broad brows
D-L3 / D-R3 · Third drawer — tall divided leaf crown
D-L4 / D-R4 · Bottom drawer — spreading fan and descending foliage
D-C1 · Centre drawer — elongated scrolls and split plume
Central masks retain their aspect ratio when desk dimensions change; outer foliage fills the available panel width.
